about: One duration model for lesson.json, read by tools/lessongen/validate.py and the S5 director. PM 2026-10-27.

narration.rule: shot_s = max(shot_min_s, words / words_per_s + breath_s); a measured scene.tts_s replaces words / words_per_s
narration.measured: 2.15 = median of 282 shots read by Azure nl-NL-FennaNeural, 2026-10-27

class_action: scene.class_action_s, the time written for that class action (hands up, say together), added after the shot
interaction_rule: key = type.format when that key exists, else type. format 'team' (a team or paper activity) has no fixed time: it plays for the interaction's own class_action_s, which is required for it
teacher_card: lesson.teacher_template holds the card with {total_min}, {story_min} and {min:scA-scB}; validate.py --resolve renders lesson.teacher from it; a typed 'N minuten' anywhere on the card is an error
rounding_rule: sum the raw float seconds of every shot, class action and interaction; round ONCE at the end with floor(x + 0.5); never per shot, never banker's rounding
